ownership.designSystem: homepage page model, component composition, shared contracts, styles and media fixtures
ownership.landing: public routes, SEO metadata, static delivery, deployment and the non-React navigation adapter

layoutContract.mobile: one shared --page-gutter; full bleed only by explicit component variant

verification.command: Controlled local candidate flow: run the DS static producer inside node scripts/managed-temp.js with BUFFIT_HOME_OUTPUT set to a fresh candidate directory under AGENT_RUN_OUTPUT; create the exact homepage-expected JSON from the controlled source SHA/content digest/manifest digest/pinset; then run node scripts/build-stockholm-public.mjs <fresh landing-* output> --homepage-candidate <candidate directory> --homepage-expected <controlled JSON>. Run DS check:landing-static-parity against that candidate before packaging.

homepageCandidateInput.cliSyntax: node scripts/build-stockholm-public.mjs <fresh landing-* output> [release-id] --homepage-candidate <candidate directory inside AGENT_RUN_OUTPUT> --homepage-expected <controlled JSON inside AGENT_RUN_OUTPUT>
homepageCandidateInput.validation: Exact candidate manifest digest, source SHA, content digest, pinset, manifest output hashes, inert payload, closure inventory, media digests and filesystem identity are checked before staged package creation; candidate snapshot is rechecked before promotion.
homepageCandidateInput.bytePolicy: Compiled index, stylesheet, runtime and inert model payload are preserved byte-for-byte; existing legacy entrypoints and non-home outputs remain unchanged.
homepageCandidateInput.legacyMode: Without explicit candidate flags existing behavior remains; a partially specified or invalid candidate fails closed and never falls back to the legacy homepage.
homepageCandidateInput.sourceProvenance: Expected source and pins are controlled caller input and must not be copied only from the candidate manifest.

manifest.files: Top-level canonical path to lowercase SHA-256 map covering every candidate-emitted file except contracts/landing-home-static-manifest.json itself; the external expected manifestSha256 binds that self-manifest.

copyClosure: all media paths declared in the candidate manifest
homepageCandidateInput.promotion: Fresh managed staging directory; full staged file/hash inventory validation; candidate identity is rechecked before fresh output rename; pre-existing output is never overwritten.

candidateAdditionalExternalHosts.evidence: Existing design-system-owned homepage action target in src/react/landing-home-content.ts; applied only to authored-candidate validation, not the global legacy URL policy.
